nodes.stol.text.t: By the quay stands a drawing table weighed down with stones, and over it Brygida, charcoal in hand. "The island's forge told me nothing. But this engraving from Bald Rock is no craft work, it's a construction. A frame, a coil, and a vortex in the middle that closes or opens depending on who stands next to it."

nodes.urzadzenie.options.[zapis].text.t: Write the drawings down. They'll come in handy.

nodes.urzadzenie.options.[zniszcz].text.t: Burn the notes. Better that nobody has them.

nodes.urzadzenie.text.t: Brygida draws one circle inside another in charcoal. "It's a gate. You can close it by tearing out two couplings, and then nobody goes through. Or you can leave it as it is. I don't know what's on the other side, but I know somebody is there."

nodes.urzadzenie_h.options.[zapis].text.t: Write the drawings down. They'll come in handy.

nodes.urzadzenie_h.options.[zniszcz].tex.t: Burn the notes. Better that nobody has them.

nodes.urzadzenie_h.text.t: Brygida draws one circle inside another in charcoal. "It's a gate." Hieronim, who sailed over with her, adds that he saw the same mark on one of the shards in Starwatch. "I know this pattern. It's not a trap, it's a door. Somebody built it from the inside." Brygida nods: the couplings can be torn out or left alone.

nodes.wynik_zapis.text.t: Brygida folds the sheets into a leather case and slips it into your bag. "When you stand before the gate, you'll know which coupling to tear out. Or not to."

nodes.wynik_zniszcz.text.t: The charcoal snaps in her fingers, the sheets burn in the brazier by the table. Brygida watches the fire. "Fine. Now nobody knows how it works. You neither."
